body.name: Exact connected-design MILP
body.construction: Use binary \(x_{vk}\) and \(r_{vk}\), integer \(s_k\) and \(h_{vk}\), nonnegative flows \(f^k_{uv}\) on both orientations of \(E\), binary neighborhood-occurrence variables \(u_{ik}\), overlap variables \(b_{ii'k}\), and one-hot variables \(z_{ii'q}\) for \(q=0,\ldots,K\). Impose \(\sum_kx_{vk}=1\), \(s_k=\sum_vx_{vk}\ge1\), \(\sum_vr_{vk}=1\), \(r_{vk}\le x_{vk}\), \(0\le h_{vk}\le Rr_{vk}\), \(h_{vk}\le s_k\), \(h_{vk}\ge s_k-R(1-r_{vk})\), \(0\le f^k_{uv}\le Rx_{uk}\), \(0\le f^k_{uv}\le Rx_{vk}\), and \(\sum_{u:vu\in E}f^k_{vu}-\sum_{u:uv\in E}f^k_{uv}=h_{vk}-x_{vk}\). Encode neighborhood occurrence by \(u_{ik}\ge x_{vk}\) for every \(v\in N_G[i]\) and \(u_{ik}\le\sum_{v\in N_G[i]}x_{vk}\). Encode overlap by \(b_{ii'k}\le u_{ik}\), \(b_{ii'k}\le u_{i'k}\), and \(b_{ii'k}\ge u_{ik}+u_{i'k}-1\). Impose \(\sum_{q=0}^Kz_{ii'q}=1\) and \(\sum_{q=0}^Kqz_{ii'q}=\sum_kb_{ii'k}\), and minimize \(N_{\exp}^{-1}\sum_{i,i'}\sum_{q=1}^K2^{q+1}\Sigma_{ii'}z_{ii'q}\).
